key_catalyst: Intensifying AI Spending Fears Trigger Massive Semiconductor Selloff
reasoning: The AI spending fears and semiconductor rout intensified on July 30, with the SOX index plunging over 5% as hawkish Fed dissent added to the panic. Despite a +2.04% pre-market bounce, the unresolved concerns about AI capex returns and China competition continue to drive QQQ lower with no clear absorption, signaling further downside risk.
